name: RTX 5090 Stock Tracker
description: A web application that tracks RTX 5090 stock and prices across multiple retailers

SECRET_KEY.description: A secret key for verifying the integrity of signed cookies

DATABASE_URL.description: The URL for the PostgreSQL database

SMTP_SERVER.description: SMTP server for sending email alerts

FROM_EMAIL.description: Email address to send alerts from

TO_EMAIL.description: Email address to send alerts to

ALERT_PRICE_THRESHOLD.description: Price threshold for price drop alerts

MONITORING_INTERVAL.description: Interval in minutes between monitoring runs
